text: **M2 implementation complete — 2026-09-12.** Acceptance criteria: (1) Onboarding completes offline on the API 29 emulator in ~3 s of interaction (test asserts < 180 s); kill-mid-flow resume covered by `OnboardingResumeTest` (draft persisted per state change; corrupt draft decodes to clean restart). (2) Finish writes Targets v1 via `TargetsWriters.studio().writeFirst` only; Hub shows the real 3-band cold-start forecast with ESTIMATED chips (R-A5/R-A6) — screenshot-reviewed. (3) Golden tests: 5 forecast scenarios hand-verified JSON fixtures; A.2 invariants (floor/pace-cap/no-eat-back) hard-reject + kotest property tests. (4) Deliberate schema change = v2→v3 (placeholder dropped, real spine: profiles, measurement_events + EAV sidecar, day_records, provenance, consent_ledger, food_items archive-dont-delete, targets_versions), exported 3.json committed, chained 1→2→3 migration test. (5) Zero egress: 0/3 merged manifests contain INTERNET + new D9 banned-artifacts rule (ktor/okhttp cannot enter the graph; TestKit-tested). 119 unit + 11 instrumented tests green. Flagged for owner: spec-sane defaults (undisclosed-sex floor 1500, MSJ midpoint correction −78, cold-start band factors ×1.5/×0.5, steps→kcal placeholder) + invented copy/formula-version strings.
